seo.og_description: Watch this video and take a few notes! There are three major credit reporting companies: Equifax – www.equifax.com 1-800-685-1111 Experian – www.experian.com 1-888-397-3742 Trans Union – www.transunion.com 1-800-916-8800 Obtaining your credit history is as easy as calling and requesting one. Once you receive the report, it’s important to verify its accuracy.
